patterns.note: Sections alternate between full-width content blocks and split layouts featuring large, high-quality product imagery alongside concise text descriptions.
A vibrant, high-contrast color palette is used for distinct section backgrounds and graphic elements, creating energetic visual breaks throughout the page.
The brand name 'ERLY' is consistently rendered in a highly stylized, outlined sans-serif font, often used as a large, graphic overlay in hero and key sections.
No scroll-triggered motion or parallax effects are observed; content appears statically as the user scrolls. A modal pop-up animates into view shortly after page load.
Product display sections utilize a clean, three-column grid for individual product cards, each featuring an image, name, price, and a simple call to action.

technique_notes: The hero section features a full-bleed background image or video with a large, stylized brand logo and a concise value proposition overlaid, using a subtle text shadow for contrast.
Vibrant, solid color blocks are used as background fills for entire sections to create strong visual separation and highlight specific content or calls to action.
Interactive elements like buttons and input fields feature a subtle corner rounding, while larger content blocks and product cards maintain sharp, defined edges.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) provide strong hierarchy, complemented by a clean, readable sans-serif for body text and smaller, often uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: subtle for interactive elements like buttons and input fields; sharp for content cards and section blocks.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced overall, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and a tighter grid for product displays.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its bold, almost playful use of a vibrant, high-contrast color palette and the highly stylized, graphic treatment of the 'ERLY' brand name as a dominant visual element. This creates an energetic and modern aesthetic that feels fresh and less clinical than typical skincare brands.
